Deep within Mount Dun stand three statues of ancient Dun heroes: Kharok, who lit the war forges; Velna, whose stone visions foresaw the Ancients; and Drogan, the shield who held the gate. 

Their legacy still echoes through these halls, a testament to Dun strength and sacrifice.
